data.action: 身着丝绸睡裙赤足倚靠在露台栏杆上，手扶胸口仰望星空，烛火摇曳
data.description: 大骑士领宁静夜色下的宫殿露台上，微风吹拂着白色的轻纱幔帐。薇薇安娜身着一袭香槟金色的丝绸吊带睡裙，赤足倚靠在大理石雕花栏杆边，数盏玻璃烛台在身旁静静燃烧。她单手轻抚胸口，仰望漫天繁星，神情中带着一抹诗人的淡淡忧郁与期盼——「今夜的星空很美，愿这缕夜风……能将我的思念送到你身旁。」
data.lighting: 冷月光从城里照向栏杆，近处玻璃烛灯照亮香槟色裙边
data.location: 宫殿私人露台大理石雕花护栏边
data.promptProse: Late at night on the palace terrace, Viviana leans her right hip against the carved marble railing and rests one hand at her collarbone as she watches the stars. A glass lantern low on the ledge lights the hem of her champagne silk slip and the ivory lace around it. The loose white curtain of the arched doorway lifts in the night air. Beyond the balusters, slate roofs and a few lit windows step down into the distant city. A low three-quarter view includes her bare feet, the candle in the near corner and the moonlit rooftops beyond her.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 烛影露台的夜风私语
data.animaCaption: Leaning barefoot against the carved marble balcony railing, she rests one hand over her collarbone and gazes up into the starry night. A glass candle lantern warms the hem of her champagne silk slip while moonlight traces the billowing curtain and distant slate rooftops.
